problemSignature.symptom: Exact-finisher candidate helper attempted to add tracks on non-copper B.Mask/In1.Cu layer IDs
problemSignature.kicadError: BOARD::Add() Cannot place Track on non-copper layer
problemSignature.candidateResult: helper timeout or rollback instead of actionable candidate failure

rootCause: The exact finisher used hardcoded numeric layer fallbacks and candidate layer lists. KiCad layer IDs are board/build dependent, so numeric assumptions such as B.Cu = 3 or enabled inner layers = 1/2 can target non-copper layers.
fixSummary: Resolve layers through KiCad APIs, normalize mask/silkscreen endpoint descriptions to copper sides, derive enabled copper layers from the board, and generate route candidates only on those layers.

testsAdded: exact finisher resolves PTH pad and via DRC endpoint descriptions

conditions: DRC endpoint descriptions reference mask or silkscreen layers
board stackup differs from hardcoded assumptions

recipe: Never hardcode KiCad copper layer numeric IDs.
Map F.Cu and B.Cu through pcbnew constants.
Use board.GetLayerID for named layers when available.
Normalize B.Mask/F.Mask and silkscreen endpoint descriptions to B.Cu/F.Cu for route endpoint purposes.
Enumerate board-enabled copper layers before generating dogbone or layer-change candidates.
Reject or skip candidates that target non-copper layers before invoking DRC.
safetyRules: Do not add tracks to non-copper layers.
Do not assume inner layers exist.
Do not promote candidate boards that trigger KiCad layer asserts.
Keep shorts, forbidden vias, outline, mounting holes, and footprints unchanged.

before.failure: Candidates timed out with KiCad assert for B.Mask and In1.Cu non-copper track insertion

after.failure: Candidates execute and roll back for real DRC reasons such as shorts, not layer-ID asserts
